<b>Sinner's Road</b> is an [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Located between [[Greymoor]] and [[Bilewater]], it formerly served as a breeding ground for [[Muckroach]]es, where they were cooked and prepared as food for the [[moorbugs]] below.<ref name=dustpens>[[Creige]]: <i>"You visited them pens up above here, miss? Horrid place, once all about growing meat or some such. Meant to keep us moorbugs livin', and working, it's told..."</i></ref> It is heavily polluted and heavily populated with roaches and their former keepers, who have been ensnared by the [[Haunting]].<ref>[[Shakra]]: <i>"There is fair combat here against the roach-beasts and their keepers, but the air is sickly and the water writhes with parasites."</i></ref><ref>Creige: <i>"That damned place's long gone to the Haunting. Now the meat's running feral and free."</i></ref> 

== Description ==
[[File:Screenshot SS Sinner's Road 17.png|thumb|200px|left|Cages near infested water]]
Sinner's Road is a run-down, boggish area situated beneath [[the Citadel]]. Muckroaches run rampant and free through the area, with the keepers who used to keep them corralled and caged now [[Haunting|haunted]].
The area is lined with cages used to keep the tenacious muckroaches in captivity, along with spikes and swinging spike balls to deter their escape and tame them with force, all of which hangs over [[Muckmaggot]]-tainted water. 
Sinner's Road is described as filthy and its waters are infested with [[Muckmaggot]]s, similarly to the area that neighbours it, [[Bilewater]].

== History ==
Before the Haunting, Muckroaches were bred in Sinner's Road to feed the bugs of [[Greymoor]].<ref name=dustpens />
[[Muckroach]]es were chosen despite their tough and pungent meat, voracious appetite, and hostility because they could rapidly breed, making them a steady supply of meat.<ref>Muckroach [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Starved pack bug with an insatiable appetite. Despite their tough hide and pungent meat, roaches breed rapidly so are sometimes farmed for food."</i></ref> [[Roachserver]]s would then prepare the Muckroach meat for consumption.<ref>Roachserver Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Brutish cook responsible for dicing Muckroach meat into edible portions."</i></ref>

At some point, vines started to grow around the mechanisms of a [[Bench (Silksong)#Paid Benches|toll bench]] in that area, eventually jamming them, and forcing [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to go through a hidden platforming section in order to sit on it, in addition for payment.

== How to Access ==
The main entrance to Sinner's Road is located north-east of the [[Halfway Home]] in [[Greymoor]]. There is also a shortcut that links eastern Greymoor to [[Styx]]'s nest, but the rest of Sinner's Road cannot be accessed directly from that side. Sinner's Road can only be accessed after obtaining the [[Cling Grip]], as most of northeast Greymoor's upper portion requires this ability to be accessed.

== Creation and Development ==
{{Main|Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas#Dustroach Pens}}
[[File:Dustroach Pens Water.png|thumb|220px|Dustroach Pens featuring clear waters]]
Sinner's Road was originally conceptualised as a sub-area for [[Greymoor]], known then as the "Dustroach Pens" (Dustroach being the original name for the [[Muckroach]]es). First appearing on development maps around October 2017, its first rooms were created around June 2019, and it was offhandedly mentioned in blog post released that month.<ref name="blog">[https://www.teamcherry.com.au/blog/post-e3-wrap-silksong-systems-update Team Cherry blog post] of June 25th, 2019</ref>

While the layout of Dustroach Pens remained mostly intact until its reworking into Sinner's Road, its visuals were much more different. The original Dustroach Pens lacked the [[Muckmaggot]]-infested waters, instead having clear waters and being filled with white dust similar to [[the Mist]], befitting its original name. While cut-early in development, an area known as the "Mansion of the Moor" was also planned to be connected to the Dustroach Pens. 

Dustroach Pens was reworked into Sinner's Road around 2022, with its colours and the Muckmaggots being added as it began to shape up into its iteration in the final release of the game. Despite no longer being a dust-themed area, Sinner's Road contained the later-cut [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Items#Tools|Dustpillo]] tool until very late into development.
